name: Swiss Editorial
summary: International Typographic Style on full-bleed footage: grid, flush-left grotesk, one accent, mask-revealed type, a colour wipe hiding every cut.
lexicon: mask reveal (text rises from behind its baseline)
best_for: explainers, data and money claims, product truths, founder POV — anything where the words are the hook
footage: full-bleed, any; reads best with calm, well-exposed shots and negative space at the top
music: minimal electronic or piano, 90-110 BPM, felt not heard
sfx: one soft swish on each wipe at most
